case.notes: Evidence-backed reconstruction of Micron's pre-quarter-end FQ3 management guidance versus its later reported FQ3 results. This is an external baseline, not a native model forecast; the normalized artifact was captured after the outcome and is permanently ineligible for model calibration. Both observations share one company source family, and this financial benchmark does not validate physical AI-system production.

evidence.excerpt: Micron's FQ2 release provided FQ3 revenue, gross-margin, operating-expense, and diluted-EPS guidance.
evidence.title: Micron Technology FY2026-Q3 guidance

evidence.excerpt: Micron reported FQ3 revenue, GAAP and non-GAAP margins, operating expenses, and diluted EPS after quarter-end.
evidence.title: Micron Technology FY2026-Q3 outcome

methodology.normalization: Absolute midpoint error divided by max(guidance half-width, 1% of absolute midpoint, epsilon).
methodology.range_coverage: Whether the reported outcome falls inside management's stated guidance range; approximate point guidance has zero width.
methodology.signed_error: Guidance midpoint minus reported actual; negative values mean actual exceeded the midpoint.
methodology.transaction_boundary: The official guidance predates period end, but this normalized benchmark was reconstructed after the outcome and cannot calibrate native model forecasts.

scores.guidance_methodology: Record Micron's $33.5 billion midpoint and stated plus-or-minus $750 million range in USD billions.
scores.label: Revenue
scores.outcome_methodology: Convert Micron's reported $41,456 million quarterly revenue to $41.456 billion.
scores.revision_risk: Unaudited quarterly value; monitor the subsequent Form 10-Q and later amendments.

scores.guidance_methodology: Record Micron's approximate 81 percent GAAP outlook as an approximate point, not an interval.
scores.label: GAAP gross margin
scores.outcome_methodology: Convert Micron's reported 84.6 percent GAAP gross margin to a ratio.
scores.revision_risk: Unaudited quarterly percentage; monitor the subsequent Form 10-Q and later amendments.

warnings: Management guidance ranges are not P10/P90 quantiles, so this benchmark does not compute pinball or Brier scores.
Guidance and outcome come from the same company source family and are not independent evidence.
One company-quarter cannot establish forecast skill or justify a calibration parameter.
The normalized guidance artifact was captured after the outcome; only the underlying company disclosure was public beforehand.
